decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 5249A/P01, 5249A/P02, 5249A/P03, and 5249A/P04,  dated November 2012, received 06/12/12; Design & Access Statement and Sustainability Statement, dated 03/12/12, received 06/12/12; School Travel Plan, dated 14/12/12, received 10/01/13 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Travel Plan
a) Before the development hereby approved is first occupied a School Travel Plan shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing including details of the location and appearance of the cycle parking referred to in condition 4. 
b) The use of the building hereby approved shall be carried out at all times in accordance with the measures set out in the School Travel Plan referred to in Condition 3a) above. The plan shall be updated on a yearly basis, in accordance with a method statement that shall be included in the first submission of the School Travel Plan.  
Condition : 4 - Cycle Parking
The proposed buildings and extensions hereby approved shall not be occupied until such time as an additional 5 "Sheffield"-style cycle stands, in a secure and covered storage area, have been erected on the subject site for the use of the staff members of the school. The stands should not be constructed in a location that results in a reduction in the number of car parking spaces on the subject site or impedes access to any such spaces. 
Condition : 5 - Sustainability
The proposed development shall be completed in accordance with the sustainability measures set out in the Sustainability Statement dated 3rd December 2012 and thereafter maintained as such unless the Local Planning Authority give written consent to any variation.
Condition : 6 - Small Developments Condition
Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must either:
a. Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required. Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the Local Planning Authority.
Or;
b. The applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site. The details of these measures shall be submitted to, and approved by, the Local Planning Authority.
c. For a. and b. all required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.
Condition : 7 - Temporary Permission : Reinstatement
The use of the single storey detached modular building, as shown on plan 5249A/P03, dated November 2012, received 06/12/12, hereby permitted shall be ceased and the land restored to its former condition on or before five years from the date of this decision notice in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
An agreed note showing the condition of the site before works begin should be attached to a permission granted subject to this condition.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to provide two classrooms and the erection of a detached single storey unit adjacent to the rear boundary of the site with alterations to existing elevations and provision of covered walkways
